description: Lanky, alert, slightly unhinged seagull scout mascot.

api.auth: Bearer token read from the TRIPO_API_KEY environment variable only; never hard-coded or logged.

prompt: a lanky cartoon seagull scout mascot character, standing upright on two thin legs, feathered wings held straight out to the sides like arms in a T-pose, alert wide eyes, slightly unhinged manic grin, tall skinny cartoon build, white and grey feathers, orange beak and legs, full-body T-pose, legs apart and clearly visible, front facing, symmetric, no loose props attached to the body, clean topology, game-ready mascot character
rig_notes: rig-check auto-detected rig_type=avian for the raw mesh, but the v2.5 avian rig path has no documented preset animations to retarget. The gull was designed and posed as a bipedal bird mascot (two legs, wings held out like arms), so rig_type=biped was explicitly requested instead and overrode the detection; the biped v1.0-20240301 path produced a structurally valid, symmetric 41-joint anatomical skeleton and a correct GLB idle bake. The spec requires only that each asset be rigged and is silent on rig type; a biped rig was chosen because the avian path had no usable idle preset to retarget against.

animation.loop_verification: Computed world-space joint positions via forward kinematics at t=0 and t=duration from the sampled TRS tracks; max bone-position delta between the first and last frame across all named bones was 0.001758 model units (<0.002), i.e. the pose at the end of the clip is effectively identical to the start, so it loops without a visible pop.

mesh.triangle_rule: Sum over every mesh-referencing node's primitives: TRIANGLES=indices/3, STRIP/FAN=indices-2, using indices count when indexed else POSITION count; a mesh with no referencing node counts once.
mesh.pbr: pbrMetallicRoughness with baseColorTexture, metallicRoughnessTexture, and normalTexture all present
mesh.texture_resolution: 2048x2048 (normal map is PNG; baseColor and metallicRoughness maps are JPEG)
mesh.skin: 1 skin, 41 joints, mesh bound via JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 with the node's skin index set
